title: The Three Row
subtitle: Three parallel rows of round brilliants, the full width moving at once.

stone.origin: Round brilliants are cut to maximize the light returned to the eye. In a single row they do that in sequence — in three rows set side by side, they do it simultaneously across the full width of the wrist. The Three Row was built to hold round brilliants in continuous parallel, each stone facing forward in the Bez Ambar Flex setting so the movement of the wrist becomes part of the piece. Three rows because at this stone count, the width is the point.

description: Round brilliants are cut to return as much light to the eye as possible. In a single row they do that in sequence; in three rows set side by side, they do it simultaneously across the full width of the wrist. The Three Row holds them in continuous parallel, each stone facing forward in the Bez Ambar Flex so the movement of the wrist becomes part of the piece rather than something the setting resists. Three rows because, at this stone count, the width is the point. Set in eighteen-karat white gold.
